text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"Now then, everyone has gathered, haven't 
they?\nWell then."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"First, please look at this hall.\nThe 
ceiling, the lighting, the ornate 
pillars——... yes."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"There is no doubt that this is the 
'ideal' mansion we saw in the photos.\nThe 
fundamental architecture is identical."

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text: What!?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"If the issue is simply a lack of upkeep, 
we need only tidy it up.\nStructures with 
such magnificent spatial design are rare 
indeed."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"This hall as well. Once we clear away the 
dust, lay out the drapery,\nand decorate 
it with the paintings we brought today——"

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
——The foundation is already there for it 
to bloom into that beautiful hall.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"...Ah! Then——!\nWill that chapel go back 
to how it was too!?"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"I really loved that chapel!\nMy heart was 
racing, and my excitement skyrocketed 200 
miles an hour!"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"I want to wear a dress and walk down that 
carpet!\nI want to take photos by the 
stained glass! ——I... !"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"No matter what it takes, I can chase down 
any dream I set my heart on.\nBecause I'm 
the fastest miler, 'Gran Alegria'!"

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text: Gran... !?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: ...I agree with cleaning up as well.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"To turn tail and run without even trying 
the means right before our eyes...\nThat 
is not the kind of Umamusume who would 
suit the racing silks I envision."

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"The jewel that Satono takes pride in\nis 
an Umamusume who carves out a path to 
victory, not a path of retreat."

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text: "Dia too!?\nUuuuugh......... Uuuugh..."

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
............If cleaning it up means it'll 
turn into the mansion from the photos...

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
"...Then that'd be great. Everyone loves 
this place, too,\nand it feels like we 
could take the 'happiest' photos ever..."

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
"Congratulations, Boo-chan! You got 1st 
place in the Arima Kinen!\nReally, 
truly... congratulations...!!"

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
"...——If we can create a kind of 
'happiness'\nthat makes anyone who sees us 
cry..."

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
"Ghh, ghosts are scary, sure! They're 
scary, but...!"

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
"Boo is gonna clean too! I'm gonna deliver 
special 'happiness'!\nDia, Gran! I'll do 
my best with everyone! Hip, hip—"

text_block_list.name: Blast and Co.
text_block_list.text: Hoooray!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"So then... what should we actually do 
about the ghosts?\nAs long as they don't 
get in the way of our cleaning—... Urgh, 
my ears—"

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Please don't worry.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: ...Huh. The weird sound stopped...?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"I will help... with that.\nThis must be 
some kind of fate..."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: ...Do you have a plan?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"...Yes.\nMy 'friend' intends to do so as 
well, after all..."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"(...I felt it even more... than when I 
saw the photo.\nThis place... is so 
calming, filled with the scent of 
night...)"

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"(...A melting dream of shadows—...\nIf 
photography were permitted here—)"

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
—...I feel like I could take an 
unforgettable photograph of you and me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"(A   ha   hahaha  ha   haha  ha 
haha!!)"

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
"...Whoa, what's with this 
shaking...!?\nCafe-senpai, could this also 
be the work of a ghost—"

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"—...It's all right...\nWe will head 
over..."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Before things get messy...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: —We can tidy it up, right?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (GYAAAAAAAHHH!!)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"—...Amazing...!\nIs this Cafe-san's 
power...!?"

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"...Dia-san, take a step back.\nMy 
'friend' is... passing through."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"...Yeah, I can see it.\nThe third step of 
the stairs... the black thing, right?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (AAAAAAARRRRRGGGHHH!)

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
"...!? T-The smoke just now...!\nThe smoke 
went toward the window—"

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"...It ascended to the sky.\nIt probably 
won't return..."

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: I will help... with the next one too.
